name: Folk Musician Figurine
shortDescription: A seated Rajasthani musician playing a traditional stringed instrument.
description: A charming folk figurine capturing a turbaned musician mid-performance, cross-legged with his stringed instrument. The turban wrap, embroidered jacket and instrument strings are all rendered by hand. Part of Tarana's celebrated village-life collection.

faqs.question: Is this part of a set?
faqs.answer: It is sold individually, but pairs beautifully with other figurines from our village-life collection.

faqs.question: Is this product handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is hand-carved and hand-finished by artisans, so each expression and detail is unique.

faqs.question: Is it heavy?
faqs.answer: No, it is compact and light enough for a shelf, desk or display cabinet.
